simple.meaning: קָטַל (qâṭal) is a Hebrew word meaning “properly, to cut off , i.e. (figuratively) put to death.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: קָטַל (H6991) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Job 13:15, with occurrences in Job, Psalms.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קָטַל (H6991) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in קָטַל (H6991) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: קָטַל (qâṭal) / H6991 is traced through Job 13:15, Job 24:14, Psalms 139:19 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H6991. qatal [ קָטַל ] verb slay (in poetry and late) (Arabic Ethiopic Sabean קתל Hom Chrest.126 , all slay (original form with ת ; changed later, after ק ); Aramaic קְטַל , ; Old Aramaic קתל כטל, קטל, ); — Qal Imperfect with accusative of person, 3 masculine singular יִקְטָלֿ Job 24:14 ; suffix, subject God, יִקְטְלֵנִי 13:15 ; of God also 2masculine singular תִּקְטֹל Psa 139:19 . [ קְטַל ] verb slay ( ᵑ7 Syriac (often); see Biblical Hebrew (late, rare)); — Pe`al Participle active קָטֵל Dan 5:19 , accusative of person Pe`îl be slain: Perfect 3masculine singular קְטִיל Dan 5:30 , 3 feminine singular קְטִילַת 7:11 . Pa`el slay: Perfect 3masculine singular קַטִּל Dan 3:22 (accusative of person); Infinitive לְקַטָּלָה 2:14 ( ל accusative of person). Hithpe`el be slain: Infinitive לְהִתְקְטָלָה Dan 2:13 ; Participle (= gerundive, K § 76, 3 ) plural מִתְקַטְלִין 2:13 were to be slain .
